question: Explain how large language models work, from tokenization through attention mechanisms to text generation, for a technically literate audience.
sub_questions: Explain how large language models work, from tokenization through attention mechanisms to text generation, for a technically literate audience.
reasoning: Large language models work through tokenization, where input text is broken into tokens; transformer architecture that applies self-attention to each token; attention mechanisms that weigh relevance of tokens; pre-training on large datasets; and text generation through decoding and prediction.
